yufluentcn-product-pick v1.0.0

- Initial release of the product research skill for multi-platform (Amazon, TikTok Shop, AliExpress) blue ocean/BSR/inventory analysis.
- Provides AI-driven scoring based on BSR, sales volume, price, reviews, profit, and competition for product picking.
- Helps users screen for blue ocean opportunities, avoid red ocean and IP risks.
- Requires only a TOKENAPI_KEY and requests; all data analysis is executed on the Yufluent cloud backend.
- Delivers go/watch/no-go and IP risk suggestions, supporting better inventory and sourcing decisions.
